description: list_blackboards finds the seeded BB_BenchAI fixture
list_behavior_trees finds the seeded BT_BenchAI fixture
list_eqs_queries finds the seeded EQS_BenchAI fixture
search_ai_assets recalls the BenchAI fixture family by name
get_ai_overview returns a project AI summary (non-error)
list_bt_node_classes enumerates composite node classes (Selector present)
Add a Bool BB key to BB_BenchAI and read it back from get_blackboard
Add a Vector BB key to BB_BenchAI and read it back from get_blackboard
Rename a BB key on BB_BenchAI; get_blackboard must show the new name, not the old
batch_add_bb_keys adds two keys to BB_BenchAI; both must appear in get_blackboard
Add then remove a BB key on BB_BenchAI; get_blackboard must no longer list it
Add a Sequence composite under BT_BenchAI root (captured node_id) and read it back
Set BB_BenchAI as the Blackboard on BT_BenchAI and read the linkage back
Add a Selector then a Wait task under it on BT_BenchAI (captured parent_id), read back
Add an ActorsOfClass generator to EQS_BenchAI and read it back from get_eqs_query
create_bt_from_template(patrol) scaffolds BT+BB; get_behavior_tree must read the internal Blackboard linkage back (guards internal set_bt_blackboard contract)
get_blackboard on a non-existent Blackboard asset
remove_bb_key for a key that does not exist on BB_BenchAI
rename_bb_key for a non-existent source key on BB_BenchAI
validate_behavior_tree on a non-existent Behavior Tree asset
add_bt_node with a node_class that does not resolve on BT_BenchAI
remove_bt_node for a node_id GUID that does not exist on BT_BenchAI
get_behavior_tree on a non-existent Behavior Tree asset
add_eqs_generator on a non-existent EQS query asset
add_bb_key must reject a duplicate key name on BB_BenchAI
create_blackboard must reject creating a Blackboard at an occupied path
create_behavior_tree must reject creating a BT at an occupied path
create_eqs_query must reject creating an EQS query at an occupied path
An empty Behavior Tree (root with no children) must make validate_behavior_tree report valid==false with an error-severity issue
A well-formed Behavior Tree (Selector root child + linked Blackboard) must make validate_behavior_tree report valid==true
